title: Bangladesh National Serosurvey Vibriocidal Protocol
author: Taufiqur Bhuiyan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6ydhfs6
materials: Discard supernatant into 1:10 bleach or biohazard waste

Check to make sure monoclonal antibodies are within acceptance range. If mAb assay control readings are not in range (50% Kill titer for Ogawa of 0.0625-0.03125 (Col 5 or 6), and for Inaba of 0.125-0.0625 (Col 4 or 5), plate should be rejected.

steps.title: Streak V. cholerae and incubate
steps.instruction: Streak V. cholerae (O1 Ogawa or Inaba) onto blood agar and incubate at 37 °C overnight (≈12 h).

steps.title: Inoculate culture tube
steps.instruction: Pick 1–2 colonies with a loop and inoculate into a 15 mL culture tube.

steps.title: Shake incubate bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in an orbital shaker‑incubator at 37 °C, 220 rpm for 3–4 h.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate serum samples
steps.instruction: Aliquot 20 µL of each serum sample into Eppendorf tubes and place in a 56 °C water bath for 30 min to inactivate complement.

steps.title: Dilute serum 1:10
steps.instruction: Dilute each heat‑inactivated serum 1:10 by mixing 15 µL serum with 135 µL 0.9 % NaCl saline; keep on ice until use.

steps.title: Thaw guinea pig complement
steps.instruction: Remove a 300 µL aliquot of guinea pig complement serum from the –20 °C freezer and let it thaw at 4 °C.

steps.title: Harvest bacterial cells
steps.instruction: When shaking is finished, transfer the culture into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 rpm, 22–25 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant into a 1:10 bleach solution or appropriate biohazard waste.

steps.title: First wash of cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL sterile 0.9 % NaCl saline.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 3000 rpm, 22–25 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Final resuspension of bacteria
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 1 mL 0.9 % NaCl saline.

steps.title: Adjust bacterial density
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the suspension to a 96‑well plate, measure OD600 and dilute with 0.9 % NaCl to obtain a working bacterial suspension of approx. OD600 0.3 (e.g., if OD600 = 1.0, mix 300 µL bacterial suspension with 700 µL 0.9 % NaCl to make 1 mL).

steps.title: Add diluted serum to plate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the 1:10 diluted serum (from step 5) to each well of column 2; place each sample in duplicate (e.g., 2A & 2B, 2C & 2D, …).

steps.title: Perform 2‑fold serial dilutions
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipettor, transfer 25 µL from column 2 to column 3, mix gently, then transfer 25 µL from column 3 to column 4, and continue through column 12; discard the remaining 25 µL from column 12. Verify uniform volumes after the series.

steps.title: Prepare growth indicator solution
steps.instruction: For one 96‑well plate mix: 2.85 mL sterile saline, 150 µL diluted bacteria (working dilution from step 13), and 300 µL guinea pig complement serum.

steps.title: Add growth indicator to wells
steps.instruction: Pour the growth‑indicator mixture into a 25 mL reagent reservoir; add 25 µL to wells 1A‑1D (growth controls) and to every sample/dilution well (columns 2‑12). Mix each well gently with a multichannel tip, changing tips between columns to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Add saline to plate background
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL sterile saline to all wells of the 96‑well plate except those in column 2.

steps.title: Incubate plate with shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate in an orbital shaker‑incubator at 37 °C, 50 rpm for 1 h.

steps.title: Add BHI broth
steps.instruction: Remove the plate and add 150 µL sterile brain‑heart‑infusion (BHI) broth to every well, including controls, taking care to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Second incubation and OD595 read
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C without shaking for 2 h, then measure OD595. Ensure growth‑control wells read between 0.20 and 0.28; if lower, continue incubating and measure every 30 min up to a total of 4 h.

steps.title: Plate reader measurement and blanking
steps.instruction: Read the entire plate at 595 nm. Subtract the average OD of the four negative‑control wells from each well to obtain blanked values; set any resulting negative values to zero.

steps.title: Prepare BHI culture tube
steps.instruction: Fill a 15 mL culture tube with 10 mL sterile BHI (Oxoid catalog #CM1135‑UK) that has been at 22–25 °C for at least 1 h.

steps.title: Second wash of cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet (from step 9) in 10 mL sterile saline.

steps.title: Second centrifugation of cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 3000 rpm, 22–25 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Add monoclonal antibody control
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of V. cholerae Inaba or Ogawa monoclonal antibody in PBS (1 µg/mL) to wells 2G and 2H (assay controls).

steps.title: Add negative‑control saline
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL sterile saline to wells 1E, 1F, 1G, and 1H (negative controls).

steps.title: Calculate 50 % kill OD
steps.instruction: Average the OD of the four growth‑control wells and divide by 2 to obtain the 50 % kill OD. Reject the plate if ≥2 growth controls are outside the 0.20–0.28 range; if only one is out of range, discard that well and average the remaining three.

steps.title: Determine sample titers
steps.instruction: For each sample row, find the highest dilution where the blanked OD595 is less than the 50 % kill OD; the titer is the reciprocal of that dilution factor. If no dilution meets the criterion, assign a titer of 5 (below detection). Example: with growth‑control OD = 0.24 and a sample OD = 0.11 at column 7, the titer is 320.

steps.title: Validate technical replicates
steps.instruction: Confirm that the two technical replicates for each sample differ by no more than one 2‑fold dilution. If they differ by more than one dilution, reject the sample; if they differ by exactly one dilution, assign the lower titer.
